top_headlines.headline: Investing.coms stocks of the week
top_headlines.summary: Oracle shares slumped 20.6% this week including an 8.5% single-day drop after mixed fiscal Q4 results where cloud application revenue missed estimates and capex guidance alarmed investors.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle falls Hugo Boss takeover chatter heats up Magnum melts in the spotlight
top_headlines.summary: Oracle fell ~9% in a single session as investors focused on $90B guided FY27 capex and questioned whether AI infrastructure spending will generate sufficient returns; worst day in six months.

top_headlines.headline: U.S. Office of Personnel Management Selects Oracle to Power Federal Workforce Modernization
top_headlines.summary: US OPM selecting Oracle for federal workforce modernization is a significant government contract win that validates Oracle cloud capabilities in sensitive federal environments and counters the FEDRAMP concerns raised in the failed Microsoft deal.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Gets Mizuho Backing
top_headlines.summary: Mizuho maintained Outperform with $320 target citing cloud infrastructure growth of 90%+ and conservative FY27 revenue guidance; bullish analyst support amid the post-earnings selloff.

top_headlines.headline: Software stocks tumble in sympathy as fragile market sentiment fractures again
top_headlines.summary: Oracle massive debt-funded data center buildout fundamentally altered profitability expectations and triggered sympathetic selling across enterprise software as investors question whether AI CapEx will ever pay off at the projected scale.

top_headlines.headline: SpaceX's $75 Billion IPO Fuels $1.5 Trillion Equity Supply Wave
top_headlines.summary: Oracle is cited among hyperscalers needing to raise capital for AI spending, with anticipated share sales potentially creating near-term equity supply headwinds for ORCL.

top_headlines.headline: Adobes Pivot: A Genius Bet Or A Costly Distraction?
top_headlines.summary: Adobe's AI freemium strategy pivot has no direct implications for Oracle's cloud, database, or AI business segments.

top_headlines.headline: Is the Turnaround at IBM Stock Finally Here to Stay?
top_headlines.summary: IBM's AI-driven cloud and infrastructure momentum signals intensifying enterprise competition for Oracle in the hybrid cloud and database market.

top_headlines.headline: US Justice Department clears Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros
top_headlines.summary: DOJ clearance of the Paramount-Warner Bros deal has no discernible direct impact on Oracle's business or market position.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Announces Record Q4 and FY 2026 Results Driven by Cloud Infrastructure & Cloud Applications
top_headlines.summary: Oracle announces record Q4 and FY2026 results driven by cloud infrastructure, with RPO jumping 363% YoY to $638B validating the AI cloud thesis.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Wins $396M Federal HR Modernization Contract
top_headlines.summary: Oracle wins a $396M federal HR modernization contract, providing a meaningful near-term revenue boost and expanding its government cloud footprint.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle's stock is seeing its worst run in a quarter-century as this key AI debate rages on
top_headlines.summary: Oracle's stock sees its worst run in a quarter century as the AI-capex vs. returns debate rages, eroding investor confidence in the bull thesis.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle awarded US contract to provide government-wide HR software
top_headlines.summary: Oracle is awarded a U.S. government-wide HR software contract, demonstrating its enterprise credibility and expanding its federal revenue base.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle wins contract to overhaul U.S. governments HR platform
top_headlines.summary: Oracle wins contract to overhaul U.S. government's HR platform, securing a significant recurring revenue stream and validating its cloud apps strategy.

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Stock Slides After Company Unveils Soaring AI Spending
top_headlines.summary: Oracle stock slides 11% after unveiling $95B capex and $40B fundraising plan despite strong Q4 results

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Beats Earnings Expectations but Shares Slide on Spending and Funding Plans (ORCL)
top_headlines.summary: Oracle beats estimates but drops 10% as $95B capex, $40B funding plan, and gross margin step-down spook investors

top_headlines.headline: Oracle shares plunge as soaring AI spending rattles investors
top_headlines.summary: Oracle AI spending plans rattled investors; stock plunged on capital intensity concerns

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Stock Slides on Mixed Earnings. Software Is an Issue.
top_headlines.summary: Oracle stock slides on mixed earnings with software revenue declining, feeding negative sector narrative

top_headlines.headline: Oracle Q4 2026 earnings beat but stock sinks on $40B fundraising plan
top_headlines.summary: Oracle Q4 beat overshadowed by $40B fundraising announcement; negative free cash flow of $23.7B highlights capital intensity
